about: The committed result of the Chemistry visual closure audit: every concept classified A-E (taxonomy), every served figure instance rendered in Chromium at 390 and 1280 px in both themes across every control state, and the machine semantic verdict. A REVIEW_REQUIRED here means no deterministic assertion covers the chemistry; the human answer is semantic-review.json. src/tests/chemistryVisualAudit.test.ts recomputes every served fingerprint from the resolver and fails, naming the concepts, when this file is stale.

taxonomy.A: intentionally no figure: the generator recorded a deliberate decline (no suitable form) and no faithful figure is authored
taxonomy.B: should have a figure and does not: no figure and no recorded decision, or the only figure was retired as wrong and has no replacement yet
taxonomy.C: a figure exists in the code or the production cache but the resolver cannot reach it (a curated tier shadows it)
taxonomy.D: generated and rejected: a Tier-3 figure exists but the critic, a gate or a retirement refuses it, so none is served
taxonomy.E: reachable and displayed: the resolver serves a figure (Tier 0/1 curated or authored, Tier 2 approved, Tier 3 generated)
